description: This file defines the code-behind class for the 'EditExam' ASP.NET WebForms page, containing event handlers for various button clicks that navigate to different pages within the Online Exam System.

classes.name: EditExam
classes.description: Partial class for the 'EditExam' ASP.NET page, handling page load and button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handler for the page load event; currently does not contain any logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'home' button; transfers to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'profile' button; transfers to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'leaderboard' button; transfers to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: eTheoryB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for editing theory; transfers to EditTheory.aspx.

methods.name: eMcqB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for editing MCQ questions; transfers to EditMCQ.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for logout; transfers to LoginPage.aspx.
